title: Not worth the cost.
text:
Cancelled after two boxes.
Introductory box: Random pens in non-complimentary colors. At least one of which was a random gel pen, only used for writing.Prices they list on the included card added up to less than cost of box. And smarties, one roll.

Second box-first full price box, cancelled after- two tubes of paint, one paint brush and a mechanical pencil, with no extra lead. And a single sour warhead.

So, not worth the money, boxes do not have enough supplies for a project. No surfaces, no suggestions, no inspiration, just some illustrator's junk drawer. Who has crappy taste in sweets.
label: negative
